summary: Jaguar Health filed an 8-K reporting two privately negotiated debt/equity-for-stock exchanges. On September 11, 2026, the company issued 557,377 shares to Lincoln Alternative Strategies LLC to retire a 6% convertible note with an outstanding balance of $175,016.36. Separately, it issued 219,435 shares to Streeterville Capital LLC to retire 2.8 shares of Series Q Perpetual Preferred Stock, following a July 7, 2026 exchange of 53,191 shares for 6 preferred shares; combined issuances exceeded 5% of outstanding common stock. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms beyond share counts. Risk-arb angle: continued dilution via preferred conversions.
